name: Signal Aggregator Subscription Access
description: Verifies that the signal aggregator's subscription registry and event stream are accessible through the gateway. Subscriptions hold the per-feed delivery routing state — confirming they are readable validates that signal routing infrastructure is operational. Signal events confirm the event bus is live.
author: seti

steps.description: List active subscriptions from Signal Aggregator
Query recent signal events — confirms the event bus is live and gateway routes correctly
